evidence.computation: The simple rational-runoff model preserves exact coefficient/intensity/area quantities. Successful results require a runoff fraction in [0,1], nonnegative rainfall and area, and supported source units; flow is bounded by the declared zero-loss model capacity.
assumptions: This is a simple precipitation-partition coefficient, not an adjusted design factor that may exceed one.
SI uses mm/h and normalized hectares; US inch/hour with acres retains the conventional CiA cfs approximation.
English quantity roles and unit tags are untrusted.
untrusted: Natural-language recognition, family selection and parsing of numbers and units.

evidence.computation: Ocean requests preserve exact signed numbers, reject physically infeasible inputs for their scalar models, and distinguish phase speed from group velocity. Group velocity is tied to the derivative of deep-water gravity-wave dispersion.
assumptions: Gravity is 9.81 m/s2; seawater density and sound speed use declared defaults unless supplied.
The supplied wave is in the deep-water gravity-wave regime for phase and group speed; these formulas do not cover capillary waves or intermediate depth.
untrusted: Natural-language recognition, family selection and parsing of numbers and units.
